pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into micro-pullbacks; only add exposure on a confirmed structural break with a locked-in breakeven trail.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 1.5 ATR buffer beyond immediate local swing extremes before deploying stops to prevent wick hunting.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once floating profit exceeds $10.00 to prevent erosion down to micro-scalps.
